tasks.short: Obtain agreements and file the accepted version.

steps.what: Check consent before they obtain agreements.
Contact property owners where consent exists.
Obtain agreements to place the properties.
Accept the agreements and set the risk.

tasks.design: The broker calls only where a consent flag is already yes, obtains the agreement, and sets the risk rating. {CRM} only shows that flag. {DOCS} files the version they accepted. Nothing calls an owner and nothing sets the risk.
tasks.previous_blocker: The consent was hunted in old mail, and the agreement was retyped after the visit.
tasks.enabler_now: A consent flag and an accepted file can be stored on the owner record.
tasks.still_hard: The owner still decides to place the property, and the broker still sets the risk.
tasks.human_edge: The broker obtains the agreement and sets the risk. A flag does not place the property.
tasks.altitude: The call and the agreement stay in full. Only the consent lookup and the filing of the accepted agreement are shorter.

reach.task: Place the property under the agreement

evidence.claim: An identity questionnaire can be completed from documents the person brings. The broker sets the risk rating. Realworks Wwft-check is one product that stores that questionnaire.
From 1 July 2026 a consumer, a sole trader, or a general partnership may be called only with explicit prior consent, and that includes people who are already customers.
Estate agents, rental brokers from EUR 10,000 a month, and appraisers are institutions under anti-money-laundering rules. Citing the rule does not satisfy it. The broker sets the risk.
Recording calls, or analysing speech in a way that can monitor staff, needs works-council consent. This design does not record a call or a seminar and does not score the broker.
Identity and financial details of an owner or a buyer are personal data. They leave the office only in a version the broker has accepted.

assumptions: The workflow starts when an owner might place a property and ends when the accepted agreement is on file. The broker calls and obtains it. Calls are not recorded.

The fields are owner name, property address, consent yes or no with a date, agreement date, fee, and the risk rating. The owner produces the identity document and the consent. The broker writes the fee and the rating. If consent is missing, the call does not happen. If a document is missing, the agreement is not filed.
The prior classes this task as human. The steps agree the call and the agreement stay. The lookup and the filing are the parts that move.
unknowns: Whether consent is already a field on the owner record.
Which identity document the owner is expected to bring.
research_questions: Is consent already a field on the owner record?
Which identity document is the owner expected to bring?

steps.what: Show the estate the others own.
Advise on the estate during the sale.
Stay with the others until the estate is sold.

tasks.design: The broker shows the estate, advises during the sale, and stays with the parties until it is sold. Nothing sells the estate and nothing advises the buyer.
tasks.previous_blocker: The sale was the visit, the advice, and the wait for the parties.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing in the record sells an estate the broker has not shown.
tasks.still_hard: What a buyer will pay, and whether the owner will take it, stay with the broker in the room.
tasks.human_edge: The broker sells. A listing does not close the sale.
tasks.altitude: The showing, the advice, and the sale stay in full. There is no shorter step.

reach.task: Decide whether to buy the estate
reach.learn: The broker still advises in the room

evidence.claim: National rules differ on who may advise a buyer about a price or a mortgage. A system does not give that advice here. The broker does.
Recording calls, or analysing speech in a way that can monitor staff, needs works-council consent. This design does not record a call or a seminar and does not score the broker.

assumptions: The workflow starts when the owner has asked the broker to sell and ends when the estate is sold or the instruction ends. The broker shows, advises, and stays. Zero incremental hours are justified because no step is removed and no upkeep is added.
There is no new field. The owner produces the instruction. The buyer produces the decision. The broker advises. National rules differ on who may advise.
The prior classes this task as amplify. The steps disagree: the sale stays.
unknowns: Whether the owner has already limited the price the broker may advise.
Whether a buyer expects advice the broker is not allowed to give.
research_questions: Has the owner already limited the price the broker may advise?
Does a buyer expect advice the broker is not allowed to give?

tasks.short: Compare properties and file the accepted price.

steps.what: Pull similar properties that recently sold.
Compare the property with those properties.
Accept the market price they determine.

tasks.design: The broker compares the property with recent sales and determines the price. {CRM} only pulls those sales into a table. A tested model value, if the office already has one, may sit beside the table and is not the price they file. {DOCS} files the price they accepted. A forecast is not that price.
tasks.previous_blocker: The sales were copied by hand before the broker could compare them.
tasks.enabler_now: Recent sales can be listed from the records the office already keeps.
tasks.still_hard: Which sales belong, and what the price should be, stay with the broker.
tasks.human_edge: The broker determines the price. A table does not.
tasks.altitude: The comparison and the price stay in full. Only the pull of recent sales and the filing of the accepted price are shorter.

reach.task: Hear the price the broker determined
reach.learn: The figure is the broker's, not a forecast

evidence.claim: Calcasa Model Waardering produces an automated value tested against sale prices. It is not for mortgage lending. It does not set the price the broker will say.
Zillow stopped buying homes in November 2021 after an inventory write-down it blamed on price forecasts. A forecast is not the price the broker will say.

A house valuation is not credit scoring. A bot must say it is a machine. An edited photo of a real home must be labelled. Staff who use such tools need literacy. This design has no bot and does not edit photos.
National rules differ on who may advise a buyer about a price or a mortgage. A system does not give that advice here. The broker does.

assumptions: The workflow starts when a price is needed and ends when the accepted price is on file. The broker compares and determines it. The model does not.

The fields are property type, sale date, sale price, and area. The sale record produces them. The broker produces the price they will say. If a sale is missing, the broker adds it. A model value is not written into the price field.
The prior classes this task as amplify. The steps agree the comparison stays. The pull and the filing are the parts that move.
unknowns: Whether a tested model value is already on the file.
Which sales the office treats as too far away to list.
research_questions: Is a tested model value already on the file?
Which sales does the office treat as too far away to list?

tasks.short: Negotiate, accept the details, then send them.

steps.what: Read property prices and settlement details.
Hold negotiations between buyers and sellers.
Act as intermediary during the closing of sales.
Fill settlement details from the closing.

tasks.design: The broker holds the negotiations and attends the closing. A form then fills only the party, price, date, and conditions they already agreed. They accept that version. {ESIGN} sends that version for signature and copies it to the notary. The notary draws the deed and disburses. The fill does not negotiate.
tasks.previous_blocker: The same prices were retyped into the agreement after the closing.
tasks.enabler_now: Party, price, date, and conditions can be copied into the agreement the office already uses.
tasks.still_hard: What the parties will agree, in the room, stays with the broker.
tasks.human_edge: The broker is the intermediary. A filled form is not the negotiation.
tasks.altitude: The negotiations and the closing stay in full. Only the fill of agreed fields and the send of the accepted details are shorter.

reach.learn: The notary still draws the deed

evidence.claim: A purchase agreement can be filled from stored party, price and property fields, sent for signature, and copied to the notary. Realworks Koopovereenkomst does this. It does not draw the deed.
Identity and financial details of an owner or a buyer are personal data. They leave the office only in a version the broker has accepted.
National rules differ on who may advise a buyer about a price or a mortgage. A system does not give that advice here. The broker does.

assumptions: The workflow starts when buyers and sellers are negotiating and ends when the accepted details are with the notary. The broker negotiates and attends. The notary draws the deed.

The fields are buyer, seller, price, settlement date, and conditions. The parties produce them in the room. The broker writes what was agreed. If a clause is not in the template, the broker types it before accepting. The send is that accepted version, not the deed.
The prior classes this task as human. The steps agree the negotiations and the closing stay. The fill and the send are the parts that move.
unknowns: Whether the notary accepts a filled agreement from the broker.
Which clauses the template does not hold.
research_questions: Does the notary accept a filled agreement from the broker?
Which clauses does the template not hold?

A consent flag, a table of sales, a filled agreement, and a filed version are the parts that move. A forecast is not the price. The notary still draws the deed.

skills_to_grow: Setting the risk rather than having a questionnaire set it
Determining the price from sales they compared
Negotiating in the room rather than sending a generated position
role.ambitious_version: Every agreement that is filed, and every price that is filed, is one the broker accepted, and the sale stays theirs.
